mechanism: Ginkgo biloba inhibits platelet-activating factor and has anticoagulant/antiplatelet properties; sertraline inhibits platelet aggregation via serotonin reuptake inhibition, and both agents may have additive effects on bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding (bruising, petechiae, GI bleeding); counsel patient on bleeding precautions; consider alternative herbal supplement or dose adjustment if clinically significant bleeding occurs.
